status: PROTOCOL_V2 holdout selection AMENDMENT (coordinator-approved in writing after attempt 1 failed); declared BEFORE the A1 manifest and admission were built

trigger.summary: attempt 1: 5 of 16 evenly spaced 2019 rows CONTENT_NON_FINITE, no clean slot within +24h -> declared stop rule fired and was honoured

unchanged: year 2019; 16 issues; window 2019-01-02T00Z .. 2019-07-01T18Z; targets T_i = 4 + i*723/15 (step 0 = 2019-01-01T00Z, 6h); build_manifest rows; admission gate command; the no-model-output restriction until the confirmatory job

rule.candidates: issue slots t in [4, 727] whose full certificate window t-2 .. t+12 (t-12h .. t+72h) is finite at every step according to the integrity scan holdout/finiteness_scan_2019.json
rule.pick: for each target T_i the candidate nearest to T_i; ties go to the earlier slot
rule.constraints: 16 distinct picks, pairwise more than 84h apart (support-disjoint); the admission gate is then run unchanged
rule.stop: if any picked row still fails admission, STOP and report (no further reselection without approval)

why_this_is_not_skill_selection: Candidates are filtered on raw-data finiteness only (ARTIFACT_CONTRACT section 3: integrity checks may read target content for finite/hash but must not select on forecast gain). No model output, loss, gain or weather statistic is used.
regime_bias_reasoning: The 2019 holes are contiguous runs of whole days (4-16 steps) in one variable group at a time (mostly all temperature pressure levels), recurring roughly every ~96 steps, and 2015/2018 show the same kind of whole-variable-group, whole-day holes in different variable groups. That is the signature of a download/pipeline artifact, not of any weather regime, so moving a target to the nearest clean slot (max shift 91h) should not bias the holdout toward particular weather. It does exclude the gap days themselves; that exclusion is by data availability, recorded, and applies equally to any use of this store.
approval: Coordinator: 'Approved: option A1' (after reviewing attempt 1 and the integrity scan).
